primary_loss.name: image_level_severe_fraction
primary_loss.definition: L_I(t) = fraction of retained predictions in image I that are severe orientation events; empty retained set -> L_I=0
primary_loss.ucb_method: Hoeffding-Bentkus (HB) one-sided upper confidence bound for bounded [0,1] mean
primary_loss.note: exact binomial is NOT used for the primary bounded-fraction loss

secondary_endpoint.name: image_has_any_severe
secondary_endpoint.definition: Z_I(t)=1 iff image I has at least one retained prediction above the severe threshold, else 0
secondary_endpoint.ucb_method: exact binomial upper tail (Clopper-Pearson style) — permissible for the strict {0,1} image event
secondary_endpoint.note: clearly labeled as a stricter secondary endpoint, not the primary formal guarantee

fwer_control: fixed-sequence Learn-Then-Test; ordered low-coverage -> high-coverage; stop at first non-reject

candidate_threshold_sequence.space: target coverage grid mapped to per-cell score thresholds on the CALIBRATION split only
candidate_threshold_sequence.ordering: from lowest coverage (highest threshold, safest) to highest coverage
candidate_threshold_sequence.threshold_from: calibration split quantiles of the selection score; audit split never used to set thresholds

splits: D_cal / D_audit as frozen in matched dumps (d_cal_daudit_split_flag); calibration re-split of D_cal into fit/calib is deterministic by image id hash; audit only for final reporting
must_not: change UCB form after seeing audit
use exact binomial for primary bounded-fraction loss
use instance-i.i.d. exact binomial as a formal finite-sample guarantee
